name: Saint threaded bottom bracket
weight_description: Manufacturer average 95 g for the SM-BB80 HOLLOWTECH II threaded bottom-bracket assembly in the explicitly identified 68/73 mm shell-width configuration. The separate 83 mm reference is 96 g and is not represented by this selected weight.
